Can you maybe open an issue here with more details? https://github.com/ethereum/eth1.0-apis/issues Thanks! ^ geth seems to take `number` instead of `schema/Integer` for `blockCount` ``` curl https://rinkeby.infura.io/v3/... -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"eth_feeHistory","id":1,"jsonrpc":"2.0", "params":[3, "latest", [25,50]]}' | jq . { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "result": { "baseFeePerGas": [ "0x8", "0x8", "0x8", "0x8" ], "gasUsedRatio": [ 0.1078204867052677, 0.12388843849116399, 0.05604411458720517 ], "oldestBlock": 8971975, "reward": [ [ "0x3b9aca00", "0x3b9aca00" ], [ "0x3b9ac9f8", "0x3b9ac9f8" ], [ "0x47868c01", "0x47868c01" ] ] } } ``` ``` curl https://rinkeby.infura.io/v3/... -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"eth_feeHistory","id":1,"jsonrpc":"2.0", "params":["0x3", "latest", [25,50]]}' | jq . { "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "error": { "code": -32602, "message": "invalid argument 0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type int" } } ``` <@!388751025789468672> does this fix? https://github.com/ethereum/go-ethereum/pull/23239 I _think_ so but as mentioned there it is a breaking change from 1.10.5 which was released with the previous behavior.

excerpts.author: ryanleeschneider
excerpts.content:
^ geth seems to take `number` instead of `schema/Integer` for `blockCount` 

```
curl https://rinkeby.infura.io/v3/... -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"eth_feeHistory","id":1,"jsonrpc":"2.0", "params":[3, "latest", [25,50]]}' | jq .
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "result": {
    "baseFeePerGas": [
      "0x8",
      "0x8",
      "0x8",
      "0x8"
    ],
    "gasUsedRatio": [
      0.1078204867052677,
      0.12388843849116399,
      0.05604411458720517
    ],
    "oldestBlock": 8971975,
    "reward": [
      [
        "0x3b9aca00",
        "0x3b9aca00"
      ],
      [
        "0x3b9ac9f8",
        "0x3b9ac9f8"
      ],
      [
        "0x47868c01",
        "0x47868c01"
      ]
    ]
  }
}
```

```
curl https://rinkeby.infura.io/v3/... -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"method":"eth_feeHistory","id":1,"jsonrpc":"2.0", "params":["0x3", "latest", [25,50]]}' | jq .
{
  "jsonrpc": "2.0",
  "id": 1,
  "error": {
    "code": -32602,
    "message": "invalid argument 0: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go value of type int"
  }
}
```
